source.title: 15-month-old infants detect violations in pretend scenarios

confidence_rationale: Pre-linguistic infants track the internal bookkeeping of a pretend episode while the real state of the world stays separate -- a represented-but-not-actual state carried alongside the observed one. Moderate confidence because pretend-vs-real is one of the four provenance categories the candidate names (remembered and counterfactual are untested) and because the mature, reliable assignment of reality status is protracted and knowledge-dependent (Woolley & Ghossainy 2013).
failure_signatures: If reality status were not carried separately the infant would either treat the pretend pour as real (and expect liquid) or ignore the pretend episode entirely; the observed sensitivity to WITHIN-pretense inconsistency, with no confusion about the empty cups, is the signature of a separately carried actuality marker.

Reality-status judgements in 3-5 year olds degrade under emotional arousal (Carrick & Quas 2006), which is what MECH-545's confabulation-like over-commitment to imagined states looks like in intact children.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Fifteen-month-olds looked reliably longer when an actor pretended to pour into cup A and then pretended to drink from cup B than from cup A, tracking the internal consistency of the pretend scenario without confusing it with the actual (empty) state of the cups.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-545's REALITY-STATUS lesion deletes the observed/remembered/imagined/counterfactual distinction at a boundary and predicts confabulation-like commitment to imagined states. This is the earliest evidence found that an imagined state is held as a separate ledger from the observed one, before language and before explicit instruction.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Only the pretend/actual cut is tested; remembered-vs-observed and counterfactual are not. And the typology and neuroscience cells both suggest reality status may be a FAMILY of distinctions (possible vs counterfactual; source vs actuality; signal-strength threshold) rather than one relation, which the infant result cannot adjudicate.
mapping.source_context: Human infants 15 months, violation-of-expectation pretend-pour / pretend-drink paradigm.
